title: Spark Stuff
description: A project that adds some stuff, like new sounds and cool animations for both player and mobs.
body:
# Spark Stuff

Immerse yourself in Minecraft like never before. New sounds, smooth animations, and quality-of-life tweaks all in one pack.

## Features

New sounds for ambient, footsteps, blocks, and mobs
Smooth animations for players and creatures
Optimized to run well even on weak PCs
Singleplayer focused design for pure survival and building experience
Fully configurable to adjust everything to your liking

### Includes

Sodium for FPS boost
Fabric API as core library
GeckoLib for animations
Spark Stuff for custom sounds and animations

Full list inside the pack.

#### Install

Download the mrpack file
Convert it with converter to zip
Extract to yor .minecraft folder
Launch the game and enjoy

##### FAQ

Singleplayer only Yes, designed for solo worlds
Works with other mods Sure, but compatibility is not guaranteed
